limitations: One sparse page, three model presets, one CPU configuration; not full corpus or throughput qualification.
Step profile has one measured pass per model/version; use it for localization, not a statistical latency estimate.
Small graph and OCR sample ranges overlap; its graph median is 3.93% slower and OCR median 1.05% slower, so no full-pipeline improvement is established.
Medium raw-graph sample ranges overlap despite lower median; full OCR sample ranges are separated.
No ARM64 or AVX-512 measurements; new production dispatch is Windows x64 AVX2/FMA only.
No repeated unchanged-code timing or automatic sampling growth; no claim of global optimality.
Existing Windows UNBOUND_AFFINITY unused-import warning remains.
